title: Prediction of the Fatigue Strength of Steel Based on Interpretable Machine Learning.
summary: GBT predicts steel fatigue strength from 437 NIMS records; 5-fold CV and 80/20 holdout. Composition-only R²=.92/MAPE 8.15%; adding heat treatment yields .98/3.14%; atomic features .98/3.05%. Feature-selection/SHAP/SR identify TT, Mo and related inputs.
